'''challenger ROps No Way''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 9 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 ROps challenger DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits General Veers (V), Dengar (V), Bossk (V), Mist Hunter (V), Hound's Tooth (V), Punishing One (V), Blizzard Scout 1 (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard 2 (V), Stop Motion (V), A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Imperial Decree (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): General Veers (V), Blizzard Scout 1 (V), Blizzard 1 (V), Blizzard 2 (V), Stop Motion (V), A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (VS4); Dengar (V), Bossk (V), Mist Hunter (V), Hound's Tooth (V), Punishing One (V) (VS5); Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Imperial Decree (V) (VS6).
* Posted 'WMAOP' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans; 'SRF/WYB' Short Range Fighters & Watch Your Back!; 'Hoth: Wampa Cave' Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker).

== Strategy ==

Flip, drain. Own anyone who comes to Ralltiir. All ints are recyclable, so destiny shouldn’t be that bad. More strat will come when I have more- right now it’s in the early design stage. Easily made to Classic.
